payload.reason: The evidence clearly describes the pruning process applied to the logical forms used in training the KDG model, indicating its significance in improving model performance.

claims.text: The KDG model underwent pruning of spurious logical forms before training, which is crucial for its performance improvement.
Without the pruning step, the accuracy of the KDG model dropped significantly from 43.3% to 36.3%.
The pruning algorithm eliminates spurious training data entries, which is essential for the model's effectiveness.
